title: Talk track (about 8 minutes)
sayFirst: Everything on screen is a simulation with seeded fake people. The 7-day retention is something we saw in a demo environment; we have not verified it against product documentation, so treat it as a teaching device.

steps.title: The question.
steps.say: "Who did what through which agent?" Show the six sources. Each has its own shape and none agrees on field names.

steps.title: `normal-purchase`.
steps.say: Join the trace. Read the sentence aloud: human, sign-in, agent acting on their behalf, policy, gateway, tool. Point at the `session-inferred` badge on the sign-in: it carries no trace id, so the link is an inference and the screen says so.

steps.title: `denied-scope`.
steps.say: A denied call is a complete record. No tool result follows, and that is correct, so no gap is raised.

steps.title: `paused-approved`.
steps.say: Two humans: the one the agent acts for and the approver. The sentence names both.

steps.title: `two-hop-delegation`.
steps.say: The nested `act` claim is the delegation chain: human, orchestrator, sub-agent. Remove an exchange in your head: the chain says two hops, the record shows one, so it would show a gap.

steps.title: `killed-mid-run`.
steps.say: The kill switch event has a session but no trace. It attaches by session and time window, labelled inferred. Then the next call is denied.

steps.title: `orphaned-event`.
steps.say: No traceparent, no session. It is orphaned: nothing is guessed, and a hidden zero-width character is shown as `[U+200B]`.

steps.title: The trap.
steps.say: Ask for 30 days. The raw upstream answers zero events with no error. The audit tool clamps to 7 days and says so. "Zero" must never be read as "nothing happened".

steps.title: The tool list.
steps.say: Three read-only tools. Try to find a write tool: there is none, because the surface exposes exactly what is implemented.

steps.title: Tamper.
steps.say: Run the tamper demo: edit, edit-timestamp, edit-and-rehash, delete, truncate. Verify fails and names the first bad entry. Truncation needs the external head checkpoint.

close: To answer the question you need correlation ids on every hop, a way to see gaps, and a store you can verify.
reset: Reset: the header Reset button, `npm run reset`, or `POST /api/reset` rebuild the seeded store and hash chain; the header button also restores the diagram box positions.
